learnings.question: What percentage of newly learned information did Hermann Ebbinghaus prove is forgotten within 24 hours without active recall?
learnings.learning: In the 1880s, Hermann Ebbinghaus demonstrated that people forget approximately 80% of what they learn within 24 hours unless they actively force themselves to recall it.
learnings.articleTitle: Is Your Brain the Worst Place to Store Ideas? Why I Built a Second One

learnings.question: In the Scrum framework, which artifact is specifically used to visualize the progress of a Sprint and display the remaining work?
learnings.learning: In Scrum, a Burndown Chart is an artifact that visualizes the progress of a Sprint, displaying the remaining work and helping the team track whether they are on schedule.

learnings.question: What cumulative percentage of the Quran is comprised of its top 20 most frequently occurring words?
learnings.learning: Contrary to the expectation that the 80/20 Pareto Principle might apply, the top 20 most repeated words in the Quran only account for approximately 20.83% of the total text.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python

learnings.question: In Islamic scripture (Quran 51:56), what foundational purpose is explicitly stated for the creation of both jinn and mankind?
options: To seek material wealth and prosperity
learnings.learning: In Islamic belief, the primary motivation behind the creation of jinn and mankind is foundational worship of Allah, as stated in Quran 51:56.

learnings.question: Which PCIe power management substate achieves deeper energy savings specifically by powering down the electrical circuits of the main link?
learnings.learning: In PCIe power management, the L1.1 substate achieves greater power savings than L1.0 by specifically powering down the electrical circuits of the main link, at the cost of an increased wake-up time.
learnings.articleTitle: Power Management States in the context of PCIe
